dishes.name: Chana masala
dishes.nameEn: Spiced chickpea curry
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan when cooked in oil, as most home-style versions are.
dishes.technique: Onion, ginger, garlic and tomato are fried down into a thick masala with ground spices, then cooked chickpeas simmer in it until the sauce clings and some chickpeas are mashed to thicken.

sources.title: Chana Masala (Chole) Chickpea Curry - Vegan Richa

dishes.name: Dal makhani
dishes.nameEn: Creamy buttered black lentils
dishes.veganApproach: Replace the butter and cream with vegan butter and cashew or another non-dairy cream.
dishes.technique: Whole black lentils and kidney beans are cooked until very soft, then simmered slowly in a buttery spiced tomato base until thick and creamy.

dishes.name: Palak paneer
dishes.nameEn: Paneer in spiced spinach sauce
dishes.veganApproach: Use pressed firm tofu instead of paneer and finish with cashew or coconut cream.
dishes.technique: Spinach is blanched and puréed, then simmered with a spiced onion-tomato base before cubes of paneer are folded in.

sources.title: Palak Tofu - Tofu in Spinach Curry - Vegan Richa

dishes.name: Aloo gobi
dishes.nameEn: Spiced potatoes and cauliflower
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan when cooked in oil rather than ghee.
dishes.technique: Potato and cauliflower pieces are cooked covered with cumin, turmeric and ground spices until tender and lightly browned at the edges.

sources.title: Restaurant Style Aloo Gobi - Vegan Richa

dishes.name: Dal tadka
dishes.nameEn: Yellow lentils with sizzling spice tempering
dishes.veganApproach: Make the tadka with oil instead of ghee.
dishes.technique: Lentils are boiled soft, simmered with an onion-tomato masala and finished with a sizzling tempering of whole spices and garlic poured on top.

dishes.name: Vegetable biryani
dishes.nameEn: Layered spiced rice with vegetables
dishes.veganApproach: Marinate the vegetables in plant yogurt and use oil or vegan butter instead of ghee.
dishes.technique: Spiced, yogurt-marinated vegetables are layered with par-cooked basmati rice, herbs and fried onions, then sealed and cooked on low heat (dum).

sources.title: Hyderabadi Vegetable Dum Biryani - Swasthi's Recipes

dishes.name: Masala dosa
dishes.nameEn: Crisp fermented rice crêpe with spiced potato filling
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan when the dosa is cooked with oil rather than ghee.
dishes.technique: A fermented rice and urad dal batter is spread thin on a hot griddle until crisp, then filled with a tempered, turmeric-spiced potato mash.

dishes.name: Paneer butter masala
dishes.nameEn: Paneer in buttery tomato-cashew sauce
dishes.veganApproach: Swap the paneer for pressed tofu and use vegan butter and cashew cream.
dishes.technique: Tomatoes and cashews are simmered and blended into a silky sauce enriched with butter and cream, and paneer cubes are warmed through at the end.

sources.title: Butter Tofu (Paneer Tofu Butter Masala) - Vegan Richa

dishes.name: Malai kofta
dishes.nameEn: Fried paneer-potato dumplings in creamy gravy
dishes.veganApproach: Bind the koftas with potato and chickpea flour or tofu instead of paneer and finish the gravy with cashew cream.
dishes.technique: Paneer and potato dumplings are fried golden and served in a smooth, mildly sweet tomato-cashew cream gravy.

dishes.name: Baingan bharta
dishes.nameEn: Smoky mashed eggplant curry
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan when cooked in oil without a finishing knob of ghee or cream.
dishes.technique: Whole eggplants are charred directly over a flame until smoky and soft, then peeled, mashed and fried with onion, tomato and spices.

dishes.name: Matar paneer
dishes.nameEn: Peas and paneer in tomato gravy
dishes.veganApproach: Use firm tofu in place of paneer and skip the cream or replace it with cashew cream.
dishes.technique: Peas and paneer cubes simmer in a spiced onion-tomato gravy until the peas are tender.

dishes.name: Navratan korma
dishes.nameEn: Mixed vegetable korma in mild cashew sauce
dishes.veganApproach: Leave out the paneer (or use tofu) and make the creamy base with cashews and plant milk.
dishes.technique: Nine kinds of vegetables, fruit and paneer are simmered in a mild, aromatic cashew and cream sauce.

dishes.name: Paneer tikka
dishes.nameEn: Tandoori-spiced paneer skewers
dishes.veganApproach: Marinate pressed tofu in plant yogurt with the same spices and roast or grill it on skewers.
dishes.technique: Paneer and vegetables are marinated in spiced thick yogurt, skewered and charred in a tandoor or very hot oven.

dishes.name: Vegetable jalfrezi
dishes.nameEn: Stir-fried vegetables in thick spiced sauce
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan when the vegetables are stir-fried in oil.
dishes.technique: Strips of pepper, onion and vegetables are stir-fried on high heat with spices and a little tomato so they stay crisp in a thick coating.

dishes.name: Vindaloo
dishes.nameEn: Goan chili-vinegar curry
dishes.veganApproach: Replace the pork with tofu and potatoes simmered in the same garlicky chili-vinegar paste.
dishes.technique: A paste of dried chilies, garlic, whole spices and vinegar is used to marinate and then braise the main ingredient into a hot, tangy curry.

dishes.name: Saag aloo
dishes.nameEn: Spiced potatoes with spinach
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan when cooked in oil instead of ghee.
dishes.technique: Par-cooked potatoes are fried with cumin and aromatics and then tossed with wilted, spiced spinach.

dishes.name: Vegetable pulao
dishes.nameEn: Fragrant basmati rice with vegetables and whole spices
dishes.veganApproach: Fry the whole spices in oil instead of ghee.
dishes.technique: Rice is toasted with whole spices and vegetables, then cooked in a measured amount of water so the grains stay separate.

dishes.name: Aloo matar
dishes.nameEn: Potato and pea curry
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan when cooked in oil.
dishes.technique: Potatoes and peas simmer in a thin, spiced onion-tomato gravy until the potatoes begin to break down.

dishes.name: Masoor dal
dishes.nameEn: Red lentil dal
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan when the tempering is done in oil rather than ghee.
dishes.technique: Quick-cooking split red lentils are simmered until they collapse, then finished with a tempering of cumin, garlic and chili.

dishes.name: Kadai paneer
dishes.nameEn: Paneer and peppers with fresh-ground kadai spices
dishes.veganApproach: Use firm tofu instead of paneer and skip the cream or butter finish.
dishes.technique: Freshly roasted and crushed coriander seeds and chilies flavor a thick tomato masala in which paneer and peppers are tossed in a kadai.

dishes.name: Egg curry
dishes.nameEn: Boiled eggs in spiced onion-tomato gravy
dishes.technique: Hard-boiled eggs are lightly fried and then simmered in a dhaba-style spiced onion-tomato gravy.

sources.title: Punjabi Egg Curry (Anda Curry) - Swasthi's Recipes

dishes.name: Prawn biryani
dishes.nameEn: Layered spiced rice with prawns
dishes.technique: Prawns are cooked briefly in a spiced masala, layered with par-boiled basmati rice and herbs, then steamed together on low heat.

dishes.name: Rajma
dishes.nameEn: Punjabi kidney bean curry
dishes.veganApproach: Cook in oil and skip the final butter and cream, or use non-dairy yogurt as in dhaba-style vegan versions.
dishes.technique: Soaked kidney beans are simmered until creamy in a slow-cooked onion-tomato masala, with some beans mashed to thicken the gravy.

sources.title: Rajma Masala (Restaurant Style) - Dassana's Veg Recipes

dishes.name: Idli sambar
dishes.nameEn: Steamed rice-lentil cakes with lentil-vegetable stew
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan; just skip any ghee drizzle on the idli.
dishes.technique: A fermented rice and urad dal batter is steamed into soft cakes and served with a tamarind-soured lentil and vegetable stew.

dishes.name: Uttapam
dishes.nameEn: Thick fermented rice pancake topped with vegetables
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan when cooked with oil.
dishes.technique: Thick fermented dosa batter is poured onto a griddle, topped with chopped vegetables and cooked slowly until crisp underneath.

dishes.name: Upma
dishes.nameEn: Savory tempered semolina
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan when tempered in oil instead of ghee.
dishes.technique: Dry-roasted semolina is stirred into boiling water seasoned with a tempering of mustard seeds, lentils, curry leaves and vegetables until it thickens.

dishes.name: Kanda poha
dishes.nameEn: Tempered flattened rice with onions and peanuts
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: Rinsed flattened rice is tossed with tempered mustard seeds, onions, peanuts and turmeric and steamed briefly until soft, then finished with lemon and coriander.

dishes.name: Lemon rice
dishes.nameEn: South Indian tempered lemon rice
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan when tempered in oil.
dishes.technique: Cooked rice is tossed with a tempering of mustard seeds, lentils, peanuts, curry leaves and turmeric, then brightened with fresh lemon juice.

dishes.name: Khichdi
dishes.nameEn: Rice and lentil porridge
dishes.veganApproach: Use oil instead of ghee for the tempering.
dishes.technique: Rice and split lentils are simmered together with turmeric into a soft porridge and finished with a ghee and cumin tempering.

dishes.name: Chole bhature
dishes.nameEn: Spiced chickpeas with puffed fried bread
dishes.veganApproach: Make the bhature dough with plant yogurt; the chole are already vegan when cooked in oil.
dishes.technique: Dark, tangy spiced chickpeas are served with large puffy fried breads made from a yogurt-leavened dough.

dishes.name: Pav bhaji
dishes.nameEn: Spiced buttery vegetable mash with toasted rolls
dishes.veganApproach: Cook the bhaji in oil and vegan butter and choose dairy-free bread rolls.
dishes.technique: Boiled vegetables are mashed into a spicy tomato and butter masala on a flat pan and served with butter-toasted soft rolls, raw onion and lemon.

sources.title: Pav Bhaji Recipe (Mumbai Street Style) - Swasthi's Recipes

dishes.name: Kadhi pakora
dishes.nameEn: Tangy yogurt-gram flour curry with fritters
dishes.veganApproach: Use a sour, unsweetened plant yogurt for the kadhi and fry or bake the gram flour pakoras as usual.
dishes.technique: Sour yogurt whisked with gram flour is simmered slowly into a tangy curry and finished with onion fritters and a spiced tempering.

sources.title: Punjabi Kadhi Pakora - Dassana's Veg Recipes

dishes.name: Kashmiri dum aloo
dishes.nameEn: Slow-cooked baby potatoes in Kashmiri chili-yogurt gravy
dishes.veganApproach: Replace the yogurt with a thick unsweetened plant yogurt.
dishes.technique: Fried baby potatoes are slow-cooked, covered, in a yogurt gravy flavored with Kashmiri chili, fennel and dry ginger.

sources.title: Kashmiri Dum Aloo - Dassana's Veg Recipes
Authentic Kashmiri Dum Aloo - Hebbars Kitchen

dishes.name: Shahi paneer
dishes.nameEn: Paneer in royal nut and yogurt gravy
dishes.veganApproach: Swap the paneer for tofu and use plant yogurt and cashew cream in the gravy.
dishes.technique: Paneer is simmered in a rich, mildly spiced gravy of puréed onion, nuts and yogurt scented with cardamom and saffron.

sources.title: Shahi Paneer Recipe (Restaurant Style) - Swasthi's Recipes
Shahi Paneer (Mughlai Restaurant Style) - Dassana's Veg Recipes

dishes.name: Bhindi masala
dishes.nameEn: Spiced stir-fried okra
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: Well-dried okra is pan-fried until no longer slimy and then tossed with sautéed onion, tomato and dry spices.

dishes.name: Sarson ka saag
dishes.nameEn: Slow-cooked Punjabi mustard greens
aliases: makki di roti te sarson da saag
dishes.veganApproach: Finish with oil or vegan butter instead of ghee and white butter.
dishes.technique: Mustard greens and spinach are slow-cooked, coarsely mashed and thickened with maize flour, then finished with a garlicky ghee tempering.

sources.title: Sarson ka Saag - Piping Pot Curry

dishes.name: Matar mushroom
dishes.nameEn: Mushroom and pea curry
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan when cooked in oil and without a cream finish.
dishes.technique: Mushrooms and peas are simmered in a spiced onion-tomato gravy until the mushrooms release their juices and the sauce thickens.

dishes.name: Goan fish curry
dishes.nameEn: Goan coconut and red chili fish curry
dishes.technique: Fresh coconut is ground with red chilies and spices into a vivid paste, simmered with tamarind or kokum, and the fish is poached in it briefly.

sources.title: Goan Fish Curry - Goan Food Recipes

dishes.name: Meen curry
dishes.nameEn: Kerala red fish curry with kudampuli
dishes.technique: Fish is simmered in a clay pot in a fiery red chili paste soured with kudampuli (Malabar tamarind), and the curry tastes best after resting.

sources.title: Kerala Red Fish Curry (Meen Curry) - Cooking and Me
Kottayam Fish Curry - The Spice Adventuress

dishes.name: Kathi roll
dishes.nameEn: Kolkata paratha wrap with spiced filling
dishes.veganApproach: Fill an eggless paratha with spiced pan-fried tofu or potatoes and peppers instead of kebab meat; paneer makes the vegetarian version.
dishes.technique: A skewer-cooked or pan-fried spiced filling is rolled in a flaky paratha with sliced onions, chutney, chili and lime.

sources.title: Paneer Kathi Roll Recipe - Swasthi's Recipes
Kathi Roll Recipe (Veg Kathi Roll) - Dassana's Veg Recipes

dishes.name: Misal pav
dishes.nameEn: Spicy sprouted bean curry with crunchy topping and rolls
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan; choose dairy-free bread rolls.
dishes.technique: Sprouted beans are cooked in a fiery coconut-onion gravy and topped with crunchy farsan, raw onion and lemon, served with soft pav.

dishes.name: Kerala vegetable stew
dishes.nameEn: Mild coconut milk vegetable stew
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan; the creaminess comes from coconut milk.
dishes.technique: Vegetables are gently simmered in thin coconut milk with whole spices, ginger and green chili, then finished with thick coconut milk off the boil.

sources.title: Kerala Vegetable Stew - Dassana's Veg Recipes

dishes.name: Ven pongal
dishes.nameEn: Peppery rice and moong dal porridge
dishes.veganApproach: Use oil or vegan butter instead of ghee for cooking and tempering.
dishes.technique: Rice and moong dal are cooked to a soft, porridge-like consistency and finished with a ghee tempering of black pepper, cumin, ginger and cashews.

sources.title: Ven Pongal (Khara Pongal) - Dassana's Veg Recipes

dishes.name: Paneer bhurji
dishes.nameEn: Spiced scrambled paneer
dishes.veganApproach: Crumble firm tofu instead of paneer and add a pinch of kala namak.
dishes.technique: Crumbled paneer is stirred briefly into a spiced onion-tomato masala so it stays soft and moist.

sources.title: Tofu Bhurji - Vegan Bhurji (Indian Breakfast Scramble) - Vegan Richa

dishes.name: Bisi bele bath
dishes.nameEn: Hot lentil rice with tamarind and vegetables
dishes.veganApproach: Temper with oil instead of ghee.
dishes.technique: Rice, lentils and vegetables are cooked together with tamarind and a freshly roasted spice powder into a hot, tangy porridge-like dish.

dishes.name: Avial
dishes.nameEn: Kerala mixed vegetables in coconut and yogurt
dishes.veganApproach: Use raw mango or tamarind for the sourness instead of yogurt, as some traditional versions do.
dishes.technique: Long-cut vegetables are cooked until just tender and folded with a coarse paste of coconut, chili and cumin, soured and finished with raw coconut oil and curry leaves.

dishes.name: Undhiyu
dishes.nameEn: Gujarati slow-cooked winter vegetable medley
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan when the methi muthia dumplings and vegetables are cooked in oil.
dishes.technique: Winter vegetables and fenugreek-gram flour dumplings are stuffed or coated with a green coconut-herb masala and slow-cooked in layers in a covered pot.

dishes.name: Dal dhokli
dishes.nameEn: Spiced wheat dumplings in sweet-sour lentils
dishes.veganApproach: Do the tempering in oil instead of ghee.
dishes.technique: Spiced wheat flour dough is rolled out, cut into diamonds and simmered in a sweet-sour Gujarati toor dal until tender.

dishes.name: Dal bati churma
dishes.nameEn: Baked wheat dumplings with five-lentil dal and sweet crumble
dishes.veganApproach: Make the bati dough and churma with oil or vegan butter and skip dunking the bati in ghee.
dishes.technique: Stiff wheat dough balls are baked until hard and crusty, then cracked open and served with a five-lentil dal and sweet crumbled churma.

sources.title: Dal Baati Churma Recipe - Tarla Dalal

dishes.name: Dalma
dishes.nameEn: Odia lentils cooked with vegetables
dishes.veganApproach: Temper with oil instead of ghee; temple-style versions are cooked without fat at all.
dishes.technique: Toor dal is cooked with chunky vegetables and turmeric, then tempered with panch phoron and roasted cumin and topped with grated coconut.

sources.title: Oriya Special Dalma Recipe - Archana's Kitchen
Dalma: A Dish from the Distant Past - Swarajya

dishes.name: Litti chokha
dishes.nameEn: Sattu-stuffed baked dough balls with smoky vegetable mash
dishes.veganApproach: Serve the litti brushed with mustard oil instead of dipped in ghee.
dishes.technique: Wheat dough balls stuffed with spiced roasted gram flour are baked over coals or in an oven and served with chokha, a smoky mash of fire-roasted eggplant, tomato and potato.

sources.title: History and origins of litti chokha - The Indian Express

dishes.name: Pesarattu
dishes.nameEn: Andhra green moong crêpe
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan when cooked with oil.
dishes.technique: Soaked whole mung beans are ground with ginger and chili into an unfermented batter and spread thin on a hot griddle until crisp.

sources.title: Pesarattu (Green Gram Dosa) - Dassana's Veg Recipes

dishes.name: Fish molee
dishes.nameEn: Kerala fish stew in coconut milk
dishes.technique: Lightly fried fish is simmered in thin coconut milk with ginger, chili and curry leaves, then finished with thick coconut milk and a dash of vinegar without boiling.

sources.title: Fish Molee (Kerala Fish Stew) - Nish Kitchen
Fish Molee Recipe - Great British Chefs

dishes.name: Machher jhol
dishes.nameEn: Bengali light fish curry with potatoes
dishes.technique: Fish steaks are rubbed with turmeric and fried in mustard oil, then simmered briefly in a thin, light gravy with potatoes and ground spices.

sources.title: Jeere Diye Machher Jhol - NDTV Food

dishes.name: Shorshe ilish
dishes.nameEn: Hilsa in mustard sauce
dishes.technique: Hilsa pieces are simmered or steamed in a pungent paste of soaked, ground mustard seeds and green chili and finished with raw mustard oil.

dishes.name: Chingri malai curry
dishes.nameEn: Bengali prawns in coconut milk
dishes.technique: Large prawns are lightly fried and then simmered in a mildly sweet, spiced coconut milk gravy.

sources.title: Chingri Malai Curry origins - The Indian Express

dishes.name: Prawn balchão
dishes.nameEn: Goan prawns in fiery chili-vinegar masala
dishes.veganApproach: Use mushrooms, topped with crisp roasted white beans for protein, in the same chili-vinegar masala.
dishes.technique: Prawns are fried and then cooked in a sweet, sour and fiery masala of ground chilies, garlic and vinegar, almost like a pickle.

sources.title: Goan Prawn Balchão - The Spruce Eats
Balchao Mushrooms with Crispy White Beans - Vegan Richa

dishes.name: Ghugni
dishes.nameEn: Bengali dried pea curry
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan in its everyday vegetable form; just avoid meat-based variations.
dishes.technique: Soaked dried peas are boiled soft and simmered in a thick, spiced onion-ginger gravy, then topped with raw onion, coconut and roasted spice.

sources.title: Bengali Ghughni - Dried White Peas Curry - Saffron Trail

dishes.name: Patra ni machhi
dishes.nameEn: Parsi fish steamed in banana leaf with green chutney
dishes.technique: Fish fillets are coated with a sweet-sour green coconut chutney, wrapped in banana leaves and steamed.

sources.title: Patra-ni-machhi is a symbol of Parsi heritage - The Hindu BusinessLine
